Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE IV OF 2005
ORDINANCE IV OF 2005
Bank Of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance 2005
An Ordinance further to
amend The Bank of Punjab, Act, 1989
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 13th August, 2005.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance,
2005.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment in section 2 of Act. XII of 1989

ORDINANCE IV OF 2005
ORDINANCE IV OF 2005
Bank Of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance 2005
An Ordinance further to
amend The Bank of Punjab, Act, 1989
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 13th August, 2005.
2. Amendment in section 2 of Act. XII of 1989.--In the Bank of
Punjab Act, 1989 (XII of 1989) hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in
section -1, in clause (j), for the words "Managing Director" wherever
occurring, the word "President" shall be substituted.

Amendment in section 4 of Act XII of 1989

ORDINANCE IV OF 2005
ORDINANCE IV OF 2005
Bank Of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance 2005
An Ordinance further to
amend The Bank of Punjab, Act, 1989
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 13th August, 2005.
3. Amendment in section 4 of Act XII of 1989.--In the said Act, in
section 4, in subsection (1), for the words "two thousand million rupees
divided into two hundred million ordinary shares", the words "ten
thousand million rupees divided into one thousand million ordinary shares"
shall be substituted.

4. Amendment in section 10 of Act XII of 1989.--In the said Act, in
section 10, in subsection (1), in clause (a), for the words "Managing
Director" the word "President" shall be substituted.

5. Amendment in section 11 of Act XII of 1989.--In the said Act, in
section 11, in subsections (1), (2) and (3) for the words "Managing
Director" wherever occurring, the word "President" shall be
substituted.
